title: Laredo Police Ask for Help Finding Ronald Daley, 60, Last Seen on Peach Lane
excerpt: Laredo police are asking for the public's help finding Ronald Daley, 60, who was last seen Friday night, Nov. 27, around 8 p.m. on the 100 block of Peach Lane. Anyone who has seen him is asked to call Laredo police at (956) 795-2800.
content:
Laredo police are asking for the public's help finding a 60-year-old man who was last seen Friday night on the 100 block of Peach Lane.

Ronald Daley, 60, was last seen Friday, Nov. 27, at about 8 p.m. on the 100 block of Peach Lane, according to the police department's appeal to the community.

Daley is 5 feet 11 inches tall and weighs about 200 pounds. He has a dark complexion, brown eyes, and black hair with a bald spot on top, and he has a gray beard. He was last seen wearing a black T-shirt, dark blue shorts and dark-colored Crocs.

Police say Daley has a medical condition that may keep him from being able to ask for help.

Anyone who has seen Daley or knows where he is should call the Laredo Police Department at (956) 795-2800. Police are asking the community to share the appeal to help bring him home.
